helpers.getComments: const getComments = (stylesheet: Parameters<typeof mergeThreads>[0], index: number): unknown => stylesheet.pendingEdits[index].thread.comments;
helpers.makeComment: const makeComment = (id: string, body: string): { id: string; body: string } => ({ id, body });
helpers.makeEntry: const makeEntry = (editRef: string, comments: ReadonlyArray<{ id: string; body: string }>): Parameters<typeof mergeThreads>[1][number] => ({ editRef, thread: { comments: [...comments] } }) as Parameters<typeof mergeThreads>[1][number];
helpers.makeStylesheet: const makeStylesheet = (comments: ReadonlyArray<{ id: string; body: string } | undefined>): Parameters<typeof mergeThreads>[0] => ({ schemaVersion: 1, nodes: {}, edges: {}, groups: {}, annotations: {}, pendingEdits: comments.map((threadComment: { id: string; body: string } | undefined, index: number) => ({ id: `edit-${index + 1}`, thread: { comments: threadComment === undefined ? [] : [threadComment] } })) } as Parameters<typeof mergeThreads>[0];

empty-pending-edits.body:
const result = pendingItems({ pendingEdits: [] } as any);
expect(result).toEqual([]);

helpers.makePendingEdit:
const makePendingEdit = (id: string, state: unknown, comments: unknown[]): any => ({
  id,
  state,
  description: "A change",
  author: "author",
  nodeChanges: [],
  edgeChanges: [],
  groupChanges: [],
  annotationChanges: [],
  thread: { comments },
});

many-items-with-open-thread.strategy: fc.array(fc.string(), { minLength: 20 }).map((ids: string[]) => ({ ids, selectedId: ids[0] }))

selected-row.strategy: fc.array(fc.string(), { minLength: 1 }).map((ids: string[]) => ({ ids, selectedId: ids[0] }))

load-error.strategy: fc.record({ message: fc.string(), kind: fc.option(fc.constantFrom('io', 'unsupported'), { nil: undefined }) })

issue-parameter-present-without-pr.strategy:
fc.record({
  issue: fc.string(),
  fetch: fc.option(fc.string(), { nil: undefined }),
  gh: fc.option(fc.string(), { nil: undefined }),
  d: fc.option(fc.string(), { nil: undefined }),
  s: fc.option(fc.string(), { nil: undefined }),
})

pr-parameter-present.strategy:
fc.record({
  pr: fc.string(),
  issue: fc.option(fc.string(), { nil: undefined }),
  fetch: fc.option(fc.string(), { nil: undefined }),
  gh: fc.option(fc.string(), { nil: undefined }),
  d: fc.option(fc.string(), { nil: undefined }),
  s: fc.option(fc.string(), { nil: undefined }),
})

remote-parameter-present-without-pr-or-i.strategy:
fc.record({
  fetch: fc.boolean(),
  gh: fc.boolean(),
  d: fc.boolean(),
  s: fc.boolean(),
  fetchValue: fc.string(),
  ghValue: fc.string(),
  dValue: fc.string(),
  sValue: fc.string(),
}).filter((value) => value.fetch || value.gh || value.d || value.s)

helpers.makeChangedEdit: const makeChangedEdit = (id: string): StyleEdit => ({ schemaVersion: 1, id, nodeChanges: [{ nodeId: id, changeType: 1, after: {} }], edgeChanges: [], groupChanges: [], annotationChanges: [], timestampMs: 0n, state: 0 } as StyleEdit);
helpers.makeDiagram: const makeDiagram = (): Diagram => ({ schemaVersion: 1, id: "diagram", title: [] } as Diagram);
helpers.makeEmptyEdit: const makeEmptyEdit = (id: string): StyleEdit => ({ schemaVersion: 1, id, nodeChanges: [], edgeChanges: [], groupChanges: [], annotationChanges: [], timestampMs: 0n, state: 0 } as StyleEdit);
helpers.makeStylesheet: const makeStylesheet = (pendingEdits: StyleEdit[]): Stylesheet => ({ schemaVersion: 1, nodes: {}, edges: {}, groups: {}, annotations: {}, pendingEdits } as Stylesheet);
